purpose: Direct release-build comparison for pull request #8. This replaces earlier PR-facing values taken from different experiment revisions.

controls.build: cargo build --release; prove additionally built with timing and development-crs-bypass
controls.engine: CPU execution; ICICLE runtime initialized with its Metal backend installed but falling back to CPU
controls.fixture: tokamak-ch-tx generated independently by each revision from examples/privateState/transferNotes/transferNotes1To2; each synthesis reported 207 placement instances
controls.crs: A fresh fixed-tau development trusted setup was generated independently by each revision from that revision's local QAP compiler library.
controls.provenance: The explicit local-development CRS bypass was used because trusted setup outputs are development-only.
controls.proofProtocolSamples: One warmup discarded, then five serial process invocations per revision. No task-owned build or benchmark ran concurrently. Normal desktop background activity was uncontrolled.
controls.digestChecking: Disabled, which is the normal prover path unless --check-digests is explicitly supplied.

interpretation: CRS and proof numbers are serialized artifact sizes, not an abstract count of group elements.
The baseline proof is JSON and the candidate proof is the new binary interface; the byte comparison therefore describes the deployed artifact formats as well as the protocol representation.
The one-run trusted-setup measurements are functional release-build measurements, not a statistical timing comparison.
